name: @visuelconcept-winccoa/wui-alarms-core
description: Alarms core — the shared alarm domain + the embeddable alarm view. Pure domain (WinCC-OA-free): Alert→Alarm mapping (CAME/WENT pairing, severity bands, ack state), DP-scope matching, server-side-style query (filter/sort/paginate), EEMUA-191 flood histogram and bad-actor statistics, period resolution, display profiles (columns, filters, counters, acknowledgement — from code, from the configuration datapoint, from a link) and extensions (a module's own reading of the rows, its columns, its filters, its acknowledgement override). Plus the OA-bound AlarmStore (live alert subscription + alarm archive over a period + acknowledge) and the <wui-alarm-view> component that any page embeds (full page or panel), styled through --wui-alarm-* design tokens over Siemens iX.
